# KYB fixtures

Real responses recorded by `scripts/record_kyb_fixtures.py` for two
small companies incorporated March 2021: `13237895` (active, has PSCs) and
`13236560` (in liquidation). People's names and addresses (including
registered-office addresses) are stable pseudonyms; birth dates removed.
Missing registers (e.g. no insolvency) are saved as `{}`.
